# Saans

> Saans helps families in Indian cities plan low-exposure days during severe winter smog: live NAQI, the best and worst outdoor windows in the next 24 hours, and a personalised plan with estimated impact. English and Hindi.

- The app is a single page at the site root; it needs no account and stores nothing.
- Air-quality data comes from Open-Meteo. Impact figures are labelled estimates, not medical advice.

## Links

- [Source code](https://github.com/shaikasadahmed2k23/VirtualPromptWars6_Saans): README with the method, formulas and sources
- [Open-Meteo air quality API](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/air-quality-api): where the PM2.5 and PM10 data comes from
